prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1103; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported neck pain with stiffness and lower back pain radiating into the right buttock without numbness or weakness. Examination revealed limited cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and negative straight leg raise testing. Neurologic screening was intact in both upper and lower extremities, and no signs of fracture or acute radiculopathy were identified.

Over four clinic visits, the patient was treated with a combination of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program focused on gentle cervical and lumbar mobility. Ice and intermittent over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication were used for symptom control. Pain scores improved steadily across visits, and cervical range of motion approached normal limits by the final visit.

At discharge, the patient reported marked reduction in neck and back pain with occasional stiffness after prolonged sitting. Prognosis for full recovery is good. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy lifting until fully recovered, and return for re-evaluation if symptoms worsen or new neurologic symptoms develop.
